questions: Does the subsequence have to be contiguous (a substring) or can it be any subsequence (non-contiguous)?
Should the subsequence be strictly increasing by index (i.e., the indices of selected elements must increase) or strictly increasing by value only?
Are we allowed to skip elements arbitrarily as long as the subsequence is strictly increasing and each element ≤ X_i?
Is the subsequence required to be the longest possible such subsequence, or any such subsequence (and we output its length)?
If multiple subsequences of different lengths exist, should we output the maximum length, minimum length, or any valid length?
Does 'strictly increasing' refer to the values of the elements, and must the indices also be strictly increasing (as in a subsequence)?
Can the subsequence be empty? If so, should its length (0) be considered a valid answer?
Is the subsequence selected from the entire prefix (A_1..A_R_i) or only from elements within that prefix that satisfy the value bound?
